cacheRetention.title: Cache retention
cacheRetention.intro: Controls the cache-retention preference sent to Pi. Support and duration depend on the provider and model. This does not guarantee a cache hit.
cacheRetention.label: Cache: {{value}}

default.label: Pi default
default.description: Leave the option unset. Pi’s normal behavior and environment override apply.

none.label: Don’t request caching
none.description: Pass Pi’s native none preference. Providers may still cache automatically.

short.label: Short retention
short.description: Pass Pi’s native short preference. The duration depends on the provider and model.

long.label: Long retention
long.description: Pass Pi’s native long preference. Cache-write costs may be higher.

claudeCode.setupIntro: Install and authenticate Claude Code in your terminal, then select a Claude Code model here. LearnHarness starts it when needed—no background process required.
claudeCode.scope: Checks installation/version only—not authentication, model access, or quota. Claude Code controls billing. Requires v{{version}}+.
claudeCode.verifyClaims: Verify AI claims independently—they may be inaccurate, incomplete, misleading, or outdated.

plugins.trustWarning: Only enable plugins you trust. Plugins run trusted local code with broad file and network access; they are not sandboxed. A broken plugin may require restarting LearnHarness.

install.copy: Clone or copy the plugin into the directory below, using its plugin ID as the folder name.
install.build: For source projects, follow the repository’s dependency setup and run npm run build. Prebuilt packages already contain dist/manifest.json and need no build.
install.enable: Refresh the list, then enable the plugin. New plugins are disabled by default.
install.restart: Restart LearnHarness after changing loaded code. Preserve data/ beside dist/ when updating.
